evidence.notes: Generated tooling symbols expose the fourth parameter as Object; the local runtime accepts an Object-held AttachmentRetrievalOption and renders the stored template.
Generated tooling symbols expose the attachment option parameter as Object on the five-argument overload; the local runtime accepts it and ignores usage tracking.

source.content:
@isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingStoredTemplateObjectOverloadTest { @isTest static void rows() { EmailTemplate tmpl = new EmailTemplate(Name = 'Object Option Template', DeveloperName = 'Object_Option_Template', FolderId = '00l000000000001AAA', Subject = 'Object subject', Body = 'Object body', HtmlValue = '

Object body

'); insert tmpl; Object option = Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_ONLY; Messaging.SingleEmailMessage rendered = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(tmpl.Id, null, null, option); System.assertEquals('Object subject', rendered.getSubject()); System.assertEquals('Object body', rendered.getPlainTextBody()); Object withBody = Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_WITH_BODY; Messaging.SingleEmailMessage renderedWithUsage = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(tmpl.Id, null, null, withBody, false); System.assertEquals('Object subject', renderedWithUsage.getSubject()); System.assertEquals('Object body', renderedWithUsage.getPlainTextBody()); } }
